targets.review_note: The integral dual of min sum A*x+B*y subject to x_i+y_j>=Cij is capacitated maximum-profit bipartite flow. Source/sink capacities are camera unit costs and edge profit is C. Total unimodularity gives integer primal optimum. Successive shortest paths with valid initial potentials augment only negative-cost paths; stopping on nonnegative marginal cost avoids forced unprofitable flow.

Iterative component traversal avoids recursion failure on long chains; supports day0 and multiple datasets.

targets.review_note: Postpone each castle defense to its latest available portal. Process defense opportunities with a minimum-importance heap; whenever army feasibility is violated, remove the cheapest previously chosen defense. Such removal represents revising the offline plan, not moving an actual deployed warrior. Nested prefix capacity constraints make this greedy maximum-weight selection exact; impossibility is detected even with every optional defense removed.

targets.review_note: For each possible waiting tile, scan counts with DP tracking sequences begun at previous two ranks and whether the unique pair was used. New sequence count need only be remainder modulo3: three parallel sequences can be replaced by a triplet at each of three ranks. Triplets consume the remainder. Require all sequence obligations discharged and exactly one pair at end.

targets.review_note: Every adjacent swap flips both cards, so face orientation depends only on original versus final position parity. Subset DP appends an unused card in sorted-facing order; its additional swaps equal unused original predecessors. A prefix minimum over last facing values removes the inner predecessor loop. Costs fit a byte (at most153 inversions for18 cards), keeping subset table memory bounded.
